description: This PHP source file defines the 'tuleap' class that implements a basic wrapper around Tuleap's REST API for TestLink integration, providing methods for authentication, retrieving artifacts and trackers, and making HTTP requests via cURL.

classes.name: tuleap
classes.description: A PHP class providing a minimal API client for interacting with Tuleap's REST API, including authentication, artifact retrieval, and tracker management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the tuleap object with URL, username, and password.

methods.name: initCurl
methods.description: Initializes the cURL session with specific settings for API communication.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Authenticates with the Tuleap API, retrieves a token and user id.

methods.name: getArtifactById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific artifact by its ID.

methods.name: _getJson
methods.description: Performs a GET request and decodes JSON response.

methods.name: _putJson
methods.description: Performs a PUT request with JSON data.

methods.name: addTrackerArtifactMessage
methods.description: Adds a comment/message to a tracker artifact.

methods.name: createIssue
methods.description: Creates a new artifact (issue) in the tracker.

methods.name: _postJson
methods.description: Performs a POST request with JSON data.
